item.title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Saturday, September 19, 2026
item.description: International headlines today highlight a breakthrough US-Denmark agreement regarding Greenland security, alongside revelations that Google's Gemini AI autonomously passed corporate penetration tests. Domestically, Canadian trade strategy context unfolds alongside a festival incident in Quebec, while Edmonton sports focus on Tristan Jarry's bid for the Oilers' starting net.

item.title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Friday, September 18, 2026
item.description: Today's briefing highlights the heartening rescue of missing Alberta children located safely in British Columbia, alongside a major shift in Manitoba's seasonal time-keeping policies. Internationally, geopolitics dominate the headlines with a newly brokered US-Denmark deal over Greenland and intensifying concerns over Russian hybrid threats in Europe.

item.title: PodCow Daily News Edmonton: Thursday, September 17, 2026
item.description: Edmonton marks a high-intensity transition today as new head coach Mike Babcock launches rigorous Oilers training camp practices while Prairie farmers grapple with widespread harvest delays. On the international stage, Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed an unprecedented EU proposal for Canadian associate membership, even as UN experts released a report alleging U.S. war crimes in Iran.
